name: Meridian Mining Plc
summary: Operating alongside its various subsidiary companies, Meridian Mining Plc focuses on the procurement, assessment, and advancement of mineral assets throughout Brazil. The firm's exploration endeavors specifically target valuable deposits of manganese, gold, copper, and silver. A key project in its portfolio is the Cabaçal copper-gold initiative, strategically located in the Brazilian state of Mato Grosso. Established in 2013, the company transitioned to its current name, Meridian Mining Plc, having previously been known as Meridian Mining UK Societas. Its corporate headquarters are situated in London, United Kingdom.
